description: A wooden ball circles the inner rim of a round pale-blue marbled tray seen from directly above, gradually spiralling toward the centre. Static shot.
An orange basketball rolls across outdoor asphalt toward a parked wheelchair and comes to rest near its wheels. Static shot.
Close-up of a billiard break on a black-cloth table; balls separate and roll after contact. Static shot.
A white cue ball strikes a red-and-white striped ball on a green billiard table; the struck ball runs toward the cushion. Static shot.
Close-up of fresh blueberries bouncing on a wet wooden table top. Static shot.
A bowling ball runs down the polished lane and scatters the standing pins at the far end. Static shot.
Capsules drop from above and come to rest. Static shot.
Dark cherries drop one after another onto a wet reflective white surface, bounce low and roll to rest against a bright white background. Static shot.
White eggs move and settle on a plain light-blue surface, casting soft shadows. Static shot.
A single blue-and-black striped feather drifts down through still air against a blurred bamboo grove and settles on the dark forest floor. Static shot.
A lemon slice falls and lands, settling flat. Static shot.
Coloured glass marbles roll along a slotted wooden rack at a table edge, drop off the end and land in an open white drawer below, scattering across its base. Static shot.
Ping-pong balls run down a long white chute onto a blue table-tennis table, bounce, roll off the edge and fall into a clear plastic bin on the floor. Static shot.
A cue ball drives a snooker ball along the green cloth and into a corner pocket. Static shot.
A wooden game piece rolls across a flat surface and topples to a stop. Static shot.
Three tall narrow banners (yellow, red, blue) on separate poles in front of a blue sky, seen from below. The banners flutter at different phases and partly occlude one another. Static shot.
A single blue and yellow flag on a dark pole against a plain white overcast sky, filling most of the frame. The cloth ripples along its length with a travelling wave. Static shot.

Two yellow daisies on thin green stems in the foreground, sharp against a heavily blurred green meadow. The stems bend and the flower heads nod continuously in a light breeze. Static shot, shallow depth of field.
A United States flag on a white pole topped with a gold finial, against a blue sky with thin clouds. The flag flaps steadily and folds over itself near the fly end. Static shot.

A single large red poppy with crumpled petals fills the left of the frame against a pale overcast sky, with blades of grass around it. The whole flower sways and the petals flutter in gusts. Static shot.
An Australian flag on a metal pole against a flat grey overcast sky. The dark cloth twists and snaps in stronger gusts. Static shot.
Three yellow coreopsis blooms on tall stems against a blurred green background. Each bloom nods at its own phase as the wind passes through them. Static shot, shallow depth of field.

Four red flags with a white crescent and star on a row of poles against a pale blue sky, receding into the distance. Each flag waves at its own phase and the nearest one occludes the others. Static shot.

One orange-red poppy on a curved hairy stem against a dark blurred background, with a second bud entering from the top right. The flower head bobs and rotates slightly as the stem flexes. Static shot.

A vertical transparent panel carries five brightly patterned track segments taped across it at alternating angles, with a short purple U-shaped catch on the upper left. A small yellow ball is released at the top and runs down the zigzag, dropping from one segment to the next. Static shot. Camera: center view.

A vertical transparent panel carries five brightly patterned track segments taped across it at alternating angles, with a short purple U-shaped catch on the upper left. A small yellow ball is released at the top and runs down the zigzag, dropping from one segment to the next. Static shot. Camera: right view.

The same vertical transparent panel with the five track segments rearranged: the yellow segment sits high on the left and the purple U-shaped catch is at the bottom. A small yellow ball released at the top takes a different path down the zigzag and ends in the catch. Static shot. Camera: left view.
A yellow moulded child's swing seat hangs on two chains over a red rubber playground surface. The empty seat swings back and forth, the chains staying taut. Static shot.
Close-up of metal wind chimes: five hanging tubes and a wooden striker disc swing against a blue sky, the tubes knocking into one another. Static shot.
A small carved wooden dolphin hangs from a thin string against a blurred green background. It swings gently and twists about the string as it turns. Static shot.
Close-up of a record player: a black vinyl disc rotates at constant speed on the platter while the tonearm rests on it, nearly stationary. Shallow depth of field, static shot.
A single white wind turbine seen from below against a plain blue sky. The three blades rotate steadily about the hub while the nacelle stays fixed. Static shot.

A polished metal spinning top turns on a dark tabletop, lit from the side so only the top and its shadow are visible. It precesses slowly while spinning, the tilt of its axis tracing a cone. Static shot, black background.
A white card stands on a small motorised turntable on a wooden table; the card rotates and periodically hides and reveals what is behind it. Static shot.
A Newton's cradle on a wooden table with a blue clamp beside it: two balls are lifted and released, transferring momentum through the row of steel balls suspended on wires. Static shot.
A bicycle-shaped wire sculpture spins on a wooden desk in an office, its thin looping frame rotating about a vertical axis. Static shot, blurred background.

Two pillows on a table and two grabber tools hanging above them from which a brown tennis ball and an orange block are suspended. The grabber tools let go of the ball and block. Static shot with no camera movement.

A light beige coffee table with a small yellow rubber ducky on it. A mustard yellow couch is in the background. There is a black pipe on one end of the table and a brown tennis ball rolls out of it towards the rubber ducky. Static shot with no camera movement.
An orange inflatable basketball is suspended above a black plastic crate placed on a wooden table. The ball is then released. Static shot with no camera movement.

A simple ramp made of cardboard propped up by a blue block on a light-colored wooden table. There's a black pipe to the left of the frame and a yellow tennis ball rolls out of the pipe towards the ramp. Static shot with no camera movement.

A light-colored coffee table with two tennis balls, one orange and one brown, placed near the center back to back. A grey tennis ball rolls out of a black pipe sitting on the table and towards the other two balls. Static shot with no camera movement.

A row of colorful wooden blocks lined up on a wooden table with a wooden stick attached to a black rotating platform. The platform rotates clockwise and the wooden stick hits the first block as it rotates. Static shot with no camera movement.
A black balloon is attached to a fixed electric air pump hose on a table with a plain wall in the background. Air is being pumped in the balloon. Static shot with no camera movement.
A grabber tool holding a white domino drops the domino into a dark-colored liquid in a blue mug that is on a wooden surface. Static shot with no camera movement.

Two rows of alternating black and white dominoes are set up on a wooden table with a gap between the two rows. A wooden stick attached to a rotating platform rotates clockwise and knocks the first domino in the first row. Static shot with no camera movement.

A yellow rubber duck is positioned in the middle of a line of black and white dominoes on a wooden table. A stick attached to a black rotating platform rotates clockwise and knocks the first domino block. Static shot with no camera movement.
A glass beverage dispenser filled with a bright red liquid is set up on a woven basket and is pouring the liquid into a clear glass on a wooden table. Static shot with no camera movement.

A yellow rubber ducky is placed in an empty black baking pan on a wooden table.  A beverage dispenser with red liquid inside sits on a woven basket behind it. The liquid pours on the duck from the dispenser. Static shot with no camera movement.
A bright red liquid being poured from a dispenser into a glass which is placed on a dark baking tray on a wooden table. Static shot with no camera movement.
A potato is held by a grabber tool and dropped into a tall glass containing blue liquid with a band of green tape marking a level on the glass. Static shot with no camera movement.
A teapot is placed on a wooden table. a piece of silk fabric is lowered on the teapot to cover it. Static shot with no camera movement.
A Newton's cradle device on the table and one of the metal balls is held up by a blue handled grabber tool. The claw releases the ball. Static shot with no camera movement.
A tennis ball with a smiley face drawn on it is placed on a rotating black platform that rotates clockwise. Static shot with no camera movement.
A pink block is being lowered towards a simple structure made of colorful blocks resembling a gate. Static shot with no camera movement.
A teapot is placed on a rotating display that rotates clockwise. Static shot with no camera movement.
A grabber tool carefully placing a blue wooden block on top of a yellow block which is balanced on a red block forming an L shape. Static shot with no camera movement.
A 30lb kettlebell is slowly lowered on top of a yellow ceramic coffee mug placed on a wooden table. Static shot with no camera movement.
A 30lb kettlebell and a green piece of paper are lowered onto two pillows. Static shot with no camera movement.
Avocado halves fall into a dark water tank filmed from the side against black, sinking and tumbling while trailing bubbles. Static shot.
A wooden plank swing hung by two ropes from a bamboo frame swings toward and away from the camera on a beach. Static shot.
Water jets from the end of a green garden hose and arcs down out of frame, with a blurred garden behind. Static shot.
A grey fabric hammock hung from a wooden post swings back and forth in front of hills, with a dark post in the foreground. Static shot.
A yellow fabric hammock slung between two tree trunks sways gently, its cloth folding and swinging, with a tent behind. Static shot.
A tennis ball on a rigid rod pendulum is released by hand from about 45 degrees and swings in front of a grey laboratory wall. Static shot.
Two ball pendulums hanging side by side are released together from about 45 degrees and swing in front of a grey laboratory wall. Static shot.
A wooden metronome on a desk ticks, its weighted arm swinging left and right at a steady beat. Static shot.
Milk pours in a thin stream into a clear glass on a white surface, filling it from empty to nearly full. Static shot.
Water pours from a metal pipe into a dark bucket that is already partly full, splashing and churning the surface. Static shot.
A stream of red liquid pours onto a flat dark surface, spreading into a thin sheet and splashing at the impact point. Static shot.
Water gushes from a stone spout and falls in a turbulent sheet, with blurred branches behind. Static shot.
A single strawberry drops into a stemless glass of water against a black background; it plunges in, water splashes up and sloshes, and the berry settles. Static shot.
